claims.statement: Local dev uses docker-compose.dev.yml which runs pgvector/pgvector:pg16 (Postgres + vector extension for FAQ embeddings) on port 5440, redis:7-alpine on port 6390, and adminer on port 8081, with healthchecks gating dependent services and a named tingting-pgdata volume for state across make down/up cycles.

The deploy/ directory holds production compose files (docker-compose.prod.yml, docker-compose.demo.yml), nginx reverse-proxy configs (nginx-host.conf, nginx-host-demo.conf, nginx-host-vantai.conf, nginx-frontend.conf), first-boot provisioning scripts (setup-server.sh, setup-demo-server.sh), production seed data (seed-vantai.sql, seed-vantai-6months.sql), and a per-customer Makefile under deploy/vantai/.

The prod-migrate Makefile target (Makefile:166) iterates over backend/drizzle/*.sql filtered by grep -v '.revert.sql' so dev-rollback pairs never run against prod (commit 45fbad3); it SCPs each file to the prod server, docker cps into the Postgres container, runs psql --single-transaction -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1, and treats already-applied files as warnings so reruns are safe.

Backend and frontend rollout use the Makefile prod-* and demo-* targets with separate server, compose, and path variables (PROD_SERVER, DEMO_SERVER, PROD_COMPOSE, DEMO_COMPOSE, PROD_PATH, DEMO_PATH); demo uses seed-vantai-6months.sql so training screens are populated.
